property_summary: Calling newEmergencyOracle reverts whenever msg.sender is not equal to c.jojoTeam() (i.e., only the jojoTeam address can successfully call it).
change_summary: Invert the require condition so that only non-jojoTeam callers can call, altering whether newEmergencyOracle can be invoked and thus changing whether newEmergencyOracle state/event is produced.
